audits.premises: Known efficiencies and backgrounds; Poisson initial mean; two beta windows and terminal survivors.
audits.formal_result: Positive Fisher determinant and confounding with unknown beta efficiency.
audits.historical_numerics: 10000 synthetic trials across ten configurations; local Fisher estimate about 1.76 s in one calibrated scenario.
audits.limitations: Neither a universal sensitivity limit nor achieved 0.1 s precision.

audits.premises: Additive common noise; finite second moments; joint Gaussian premise only for exact acceptance.
audits.formal_result: Common-mode cancellation, covariance of channel-specific noise, Chebyshev bound and conditional Gaussian formula.
audits.historical_numerics: 76 regimes with 100000 synthetic event pairs each; semantic reproduction.
audits.limitations: No measured hardware jitter or universal erasure contribution.

audits.premises: Round-robin lanes; postulated service upper bound; constant service for overload proof.
audits.formal_result: Bounded waiting when S_max <= M*arrival_interval; divergence for constant S > M*arrival_interval.
audits.historical_numerics: 192 regimes; 32 lanes remove waiting for conditional 3 ms service; saved CPU service times overflow 64 lanes even with periodic modeled arrivals.
audits.limitations: CPU timings are not hardware WCET; parallelism does not shorten individual service.

audits.premises: Specified constant controller schedule and ideal resources.
audits.formal_result: Controller terminates in exactly 2960 cycles regardless of error/erasure pattern.
audits.historical_numerics: 64 vectors agree with reference statuses and candidates; conditional 11.84/5.92 microseconds at 250/500 MHz.
audits.limitations: No general RS implementation proof, RTL refinement, physical clock feasibility or hardware WCET.

audits.premises: IID slot erasures and substitutions; specified rep5 tie/byte erasure rules.
audits.historical_numerics: Rational enclosing intervals near 1.393e-6 for the multinomial tail; CRC32 collision retained.
audits.limitations: Not a PER certificate for the executable decoder; interleaving alone does not justify IID transfer.

audits.premises: Post-thermalization diffusion; declared geometry, material constants and external biological threshold.
audits.formal_result: No Lean theorem for this numerical audit.
audits.historical_numerics: 98 regimes; global normalized energy residual about 1.34e-11.
audits.limitations: All four combined mesh/time convergence tests failed; D_max indeterminate; local temperature accuracy and biological integrity unestablished.

audits.premises: External entropy/sampling security premises; separate leakage and security budgets; authentication required.
audits.formal_result: Scalar floor equivalence and explicit abort guards, not a complete quantum security theorem.
audits.historical_numerics: Conditional budgets 2764/2275 bits; released bits zero because authentication is absent, with consistency failure additionally in intercept scenario.
audits.limitations: Certified SKR remains unestablished; candidate strings are not secret-key certificates.

audits.premises: Synthetic training/test splits; threshold grid and training false-alarm constraint.
audits.formal_result: Counterexamples to universal convexity and concavity of threshold mutual information.
audits.historical_numerics: 289 grid points; chosen 0.75/0.75; held-out MI 0.2897 to 0.3163 bits/signal slot, FPR 0.379% to 0.778%.
audits.limitations: Best admissible tested grid point only; no continuous local/global optimum or channel-with-memory capacity certificate.

audits.premises: Specified finite-dimensional oscillation model, geometries, energies and nuisance flux/efficiency.
audits.historical_numerics: 32 configurations and six regularized fits; untraversed layers and flux-times-efficiency confounding.
audits.limitations: Not universal tomography impossibility or a proof of nonlinear identifiability or physical instrumentation.

audits.premises: Historical projection of 38 scenarios with explicitly scoped metadata.
audits.formal_result: NC01-NC14 are Python/JSON predicates, not Lean theorems.
audits.historical_numerics: 14 negative predicates reject their invalid composite fixtures.
audits.limitations: Negative metadata filters do not prove physics or cryptographic security; historical 8/3/3 coverage classification remains separate.
